annotations.text: SCROLL-CAMERA STORYBOARD — read left to right: boot sequence, then one continuous scroll drives a virtual camera across the other three states.
State 1: camera locked in tight (1.0x) on the HERO node — this is exactly where a normal site would start.
State 2 (mid-scroll): the camera pulls back and reveals the whole site as a connected node graph. This is the 'graph hive' — scroll position maps directly to camera zoom/pan, not to a page position.
Mechanic: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrubs a single transform (translateX/Y + scale) on the whole canvas. Nodes and edges are real SVG/DOM, so this state is never a photo — it's live layout.
State 3: camera pushes back in (1.0x) onto the PROJECTS node. Continuing to scroll would pull back out to the hive and push into the next node (Skills, About, Education).
